WordPress plugin that gives site owners a reliable way to request or schedule browser refreshes for visitors currently viewing their site.

The plugin started in 2017 as my fix for a simple problem with single-page applications: when a new version is deployed, connected browsers may keep running stale client-side code until users manually refresh. Force Refresh closes that gap with one-click site-wide refreshes, scheduled refreshes, targeted page/post refreshes, configurable polling intervals, and role-based permissions.

The plugin has grown into a maintained WordPress.org project with 4,000+ active installations, a custom Vue-powered admin interface, troubleshooting tools, release notes, and an optional static file polling mode for reducing server load on higher-traffic sites.
